notes.title: v0.19 - Food update preview!
notes.content:
v0.19 is released!

I would like to showcase the first preview of the food update. I have decided to show an early experimental preview of it, and you can test it out by enabling it in the main menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/f81d2c118aacdf4828722af391847e6e848128a1.png[/img]

When enabled, the food feature will be enabled in your game. This must be enabled manually each time the game starts up.

[h2]New Food Buildings[/h2]
New buildings will be added: Farms, Biolabs, Fishing Huts, as well as new food resources!

The farm produces vegetables. In the future, farms will only be buildable on fertile soil found on mountainous islands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/b3804cd377f0ff585d9888949ffe868d483c1b66.png[/img]

Vegetables won't be enough after awhile. Your workforce will want more food variety after awhile. When you have underwater unlocked, you can build Fishing Huts to get Fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/318164ce4fd082ed2c62b12e689934721fe085c1.png[/img]

Getting more food variety will provide productivity bonuses - occasionally alien meat will drop from destroyed ships. You can't eat them, but they can be processed in biolabs to be turned into edible, yummy alien meat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/6bd9de7ab9358b8d087823f17bcef03562e43df1.png[/img]

Improvements have also been made in other areas.

[b]Full v0.19 changelog:[/b]

Add experimental food feature: Toggled in main menu
Increase camera's max zoom
Fix HP bars appearing at screen corner when enemy spawns
Change perks UI to prepare for Perks Update

Let me know if you get to try the update!

notes.title: Underwater biome reveal!
notes.content:
I would like to reveal a sneak peek of the underwater buildings and resources. [b]The underwater update will be available next Friday![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/8505833a65e27d48154b9af3cadda2dbafecf7a8.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Buildings
[/h2]
To access underwater, you need to build the Nautilus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/b38be5a492bbf49535369396e0e6771996bf1a35.png[/img]

You can then use it to teleport underwater, or use a shortcut key to do so.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/0ca9137e698b97d01d6fab5def660961cdd7890b.gif[/img]

[h2]New Resources
[/h2]While underwater, you can mine two new minerals underwater - Abyssite, and a rare explosive ore, Etherium. Abyssite is a waterproof ore used to build mid-tier structures, while Etherium is a very rare end-game resource.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/a882e0b475b4851688a34ac7a57f2cea965e5d1c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Submarines
[/h2]Instead of foundations, you build submarines to expand your buildable space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/b35b9daeba59f6b49ad894646581c493217bebef.gif[/img]

Underwater is scheduled to release next Friday! As always, let me know your thoughts here or on Discord~

-YYZ

notes.title: v0.16 - Assemblers and Modules!
notes.content:
v0.16 is released!

The new assembler building has been added! It is meant as a mid-game building.

[h1]New building: Assembler[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/72505ec3917f2340fffb15114f2bffec59cd963b.png[/img]

The assembler produces modules! You get a random module every 60 seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/529b99553cc10609d56956f3c9220e54f30d92df.png[/img]

[h1]New mechanic: Modules[/h1]
Modules are like "equipment" that can be inserted into buildings to boost its stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/b90a46e81c8b6d372dd29c3537f7e3e96f338827.gif[/img]

You can make a building produce resources faster. Or decrease its energy consumption. Or decrease its heat production (for relevant buildings). There is even a combat module that boosts turret's attack speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/0a0e96372182b79fca1540b619fc0b83659238ae.png[/img]

Higher-end buildings have more module slots. Some buildings may start with just two slots, but increase their number of slots when upgraded!

Up next, I am working on beacons, buildings which buff the stats of buildings near it. They will cost modules to build, but they are a one-time cost and will passively boost nearby buildings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/3c6bb70e8e138affbd9360e09aaf04af93b1d1cc.jpg[/img]

This update also fixes Xenite not dropping, and after obtaining your first Xenite, you can see how many more kills are required to get the next Xenite. As your drop rate increases, the number of kills required to get Xenite goes down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/afe0a4d9a0bb424e3434a197557f16afd6f84a17.png[/img]

[b]Changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Several building types can now equip modules
[*] Add assembler building
[*] Add speed module
[*] Add efficiency module
[*] Add production module
[*] Add cooling module
[*] Add combat module
[/list]

[b]Fixes:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Xenite did not drop
[*] Unable to build Xenora
[*] Unable to unlock City
[/list]

-YYZ

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3558060/Last_Fuse/
[url=yyzstudio.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/07da4d9d6f461d441e89fcdb3044adcd64037b05.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: v0.15 - New buildings, Xenite!
notes.content:
v0.15 is released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/232d6a7a82f85c35a6318a6e51788affd1442b32.gif[/img]

You can now unlock new buildings when launching bombs.

[*] Add Xenora building

Feel free to chat or share your suggestions as I actively push weekly updates to the game every Friday!

notes.title: v0.14.0 - Bomb Upgrades!
notes.content:
Hey all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/488f7470562e6b111ba92d61f1d918e06f2a10bc.jpg[/img]

I've added bomb tiers! You can now upgrade your bomb to deal more damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/da9ce832239915cd4e5766fc2c5f8f7898930b45.png[/img]

The mothership has also had its HP increased.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/bc8446b061faa593ecf59f302823a71d0bf266fc.png[/img]

Bomb tiers are still a work in progress and will be rebalanced as the game is developed.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Add bomb tiers: You can now upgrade your bomb
[*] Mothership HP x10
[*] Add Give Feedback button
[*] Add full version details when game is won
[*] Add quality selection screen
[*] Fix heat storage/battery upgrade saying x1.5 when it should be x2
[*] Fix plane build overlap bug
[/list]

Feel free to let me know what you think!
